test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank by selecting the appropriate word from the given options that would complete the collocation.**

The judge directed the advocate general to ________ an enquiry on the case.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'hold.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that would complete the **collocation **is '**hold**'.
 
• **Hold an enquiry** means to have or conduct an official inquiry.
 
 
• Example: Is the government going to **hold another inquiry** into police corruption?
 
 
 
• The context of the sentence is that the judge asked the advocate general **to conduct an official inquiry** into the case.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "hold."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Complete Sentence:__ *The judge directed the advocate general to **__hold__** an enquiry on the case.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• A **collocation **is two or more words that often go together. These combinations just sound "right" to native English speakers, who use them all the time. 

 
 
• Example: Heavy rain, high temperature, scenic view, winding road, blissfully ignorant etc.
